title: Preview card duplicates the weather card's chrome and layout math instead of sharing a card primitive
detail: The weather card (draw_forecast_panel) and the new upgrade-preview card (draw_upgrade_preview) inline identical translucent-card + border rects and the same h/title_h/pad height math. A third panel copies it again; the card look can drift across copies.
recommended_fix: Extract a small draw_card(v, x, y, w, h) helper in the render package and call it from both sites; keep the per-card row rendering inline.

title: Panel labels pair counts as "flows" — Route_Shift entries are (from,dst) pairs, not packet flows
detail: The magnet telegraph and row lines aggregate one entry per shifted node pair, then render "N flows". A pair carries many packets (the demo spawns four per pair), so the displayed number is a pair count, not a flow count.
recommended_fix: Either relabel the aggregation unit (e.g. "affects N routes") or count actual demand flows per pair; keep the honesty contract of the prediction surface.
